title: Atom / relation / logic-group ground-truth states
description: Ground-truth atoms, relations, temporal relations, and bounded-logic groups for a query family, each with its human-labeled evidence state. Ground-truth labels use only supported/contradicted/unobservable. `undetermined` is a SYSTEM failure state (verifier could not decide) and is never a ground-truth label (§4.1, §22.1(4)). Mirrors the parser atom schema in §13.1 so labels line up with QueryPlan atoms owned by Member 2.

GroundTruthState.description: Human ground-truth label. Excludes `undetermined`, which is only ever a system output.

Atom.description: gt_state is present for families with at least one ground-truth interval (a target event to judge). It is omitted for empty-set (cardinality=zero) families, which have no target candidate to assign a per-atom evidence state.

text_span.description: Quotes or maps directly to a span of the request; the parser cannot invent attributes (§13.2).

gt_reason.description: Human reason aligned with the verifier reason_code vocabulary (§17.2), excluding system-failure reasons.

predicate.description: Supported relation predicates (§13.1). Relations do not become independent object claims.

same_actor_required.description: Short, visually-continuous same-actor binding only. Long-gap same_actor_required=true is unsupported and rejected before retrieval (§13.2).

operator.description: Supported bounded algebra only. `any`=bounded OR over a small visible list; `visible_none`=visible absence inside one assessable episode; `count`=small cardinality over anonymous tracklets in one continuous camera interval (§2.2, §13.2).

observation_scope.description: Formal observation interval the operator runs inside. `visible_none`/`count` are only decisive when this scope is assessable and observation ticks are complete.

gt_outcome.description: Human ground-truth outcome. `unresolved` is required when fragmentation/occlusion/missing coverage make the predicate unsafe (§14.3); `unobservable` when the region cannot be judged.
